name: What is the typical cost range for installing a low threshold shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for installing a low threshold shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a low threshold shower can vary significantly based on factors like the size of the shower, materials chosen (tiles, fixtures, glass enclosure), plumbing modifications, and the complexity of waterproofing. Generally, homeowners in the Bay Area can expect a range from $8,000 to $20,000 or more for a professional installation that includes demolition, waterproofing, and finish work. Custom designs or extensive structural changes will typically fall at the higher end of this spectrum.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost typically ranges from $8,000 to $20,000+, depending on size, materials, and complexity. This includes demolition, waterproofing, and finish work.
